g.text: Computed depletion-approximation example at300 K using ε_s=11.7ε₀ and n_i=10¹⁰ cm⁻³. Uniform abrupt doping, no breakdown, edge/fringing or diffusion
capacitance. For graded junctions, bias exponent differs. Plot abscissa is positive reverse magnitude; forward-bias diffusion/storage capacitance is
